release_blockers.instruction: Phase 1: report only defects that should block public replacement of v1.3.3. Do not report medium, low, optional, taste, wording-polish, or nice-to-have issues. A finding is CRITICAL only if it makes the release scientifically false, misleading, non-publication-grade, or structurally invalid. A finding is HIGH only if a serious journal editor or hostile expert would reasonably stop the release until repaired. If the issue can wait for post-release polish, omit it entirely in this phase.

findings.issue: The master monograph still contains generated ledger/source-route prose inside the public scientific manuscript, so it is not one integrated publication-grade monograph.
findings.evidence: The claim/evidence sections contain concatenated field text such as 'Support route: ... repository path repository path ...', 'public proof sheet ... Bounded to stated theorem assumptions', and 'boundary..'. The annex also includes raw generator phrasing: 'Content: Oc133 Bounded Synthesis Support Summary For Content...' followed by repeated source-route boundary boilerplate.
findings.required_repair: Rewrite the affected claim-by-claim and annex material as edited scientific prose. Move raw source-route digests, repeated boundary boilerplate, and machine-ledger text to the evidence package. Re-audit the master PDF text extraction to confirm theorem/evidence navigation is readable prose.

findings.issue: Unresolved placeholder notation appears in major scientific section headings.
findings.evidence: The table of contents and body include 'scoped Falsifiability Criteria', 'scoped Prediction Constraints', and 'Process Schema Under scoped'. These are not polished technical terms as printed and appear in falsifiability, prediction, and process chapters.
findings.required_repair: Replace every unresolved 'scoped' placeholder with the intended defined term or rewrite the affected headings and paragraphs. Run a public-text audit for generator placeholders and malformed technical labels before release.

findings.issue: The replay matrix corrupts a key input path in the public PDF text, weakening the independent reproducibility route.
findings.evidence: Section 6.3 prints 'Inputs: repository path validation/target_blind/OC133_TARGET' before switching to the public evidence path, rather than preserving the full repository path 'validation/target_blind/OC133_TARGET_BLIND_PREDICTION_TABLE.json'.
findings.required_repair: Typeset long commands and file paths in wrapped verbatim blocks or a layout that preserves exact paths visually and in text extraction. Re-run the PDF text audit and verify every command/input/output path in the methods companion is complete.

findings.issue: The master monograph still contains generated route/control-sheet prose and source-digest residue, so it is not fully publication-grade integrated scientific prose.
findings.evidence: Appendix text includes machine-like repetition such as “Content: Oc133 Bounded Synthesis Support Summary For Content...” and “integration obligation is satisfied only when...”, reading as a generated ledger rather than manuscript prose.
findings.required_repair: Rewrite or remove generated digest/control-language blocks; convert remaining source-route material into normal scholarly prose or move it to the evidence package.

findings.issue: The master monograph’s structure still appears as an assembled legacy monolith rather than one integrated manuscript.
findings.evidence: The contents show an early “Complete Scientific Argument” followed by large legacy/extended sections, page jumps, provenance annexes, and machine-readable table references; this undercuts the stated claim that the monograph is not old PDF plus delta material.
findings.required_repair: Reorganize the monograph into a continuous scholarly argument with appendices clearly separated, all legacy/provenance material subordinated, and no apparent delta-packet or raw-corpus remnants in the narrative spine.

findings.issue: The reviewer map is still heavily dominated by repeated locator/register prose, weakening its function as coherent adversarial scientific prose.
findings.evidence: Challenge sections repeatedly enumerate files, declarations, case families, and reopening boilerplate in long blocks rather than maintaining a clear objection-response argument.
findings.required_repair: Condense repeated locators into tables or appendix references and rewrite each challenge as readable prose: objection, threatened claim, evidence answer, residual risk, reopening condition.

findings.issue: The methods companion contains serious extraction/layout and table-flow artifacts that compromise publication-grade readability.
findings.evidence: The protocol matrix is split into disjoint fragments across pages, with columns such as “Scientific interpretation” and “Failure route” detached from row labels.
findings.required_repair: Reformat protocol matrices and command mappings so the PDF text flow remains readable after extraction; use prose lists or properly repeated table headers where needed.

findings.issue: The master monograph is not fully integrated as a publication-grade manuscript; a large late section reads as a generated source-route/control digest rather than scientific prose.
findings.evidence: Text audit shows 179 occurrences of source-route language, including repeated blocks such as “K Levels: K0 For K Levels: K0, public-manuscript integration contributes...” and “represents this source route as an explanatory digest,” plus “Synthesis checkpoint after ... source routes.” The supplied excerpt also shows “Content: Oc133 Bounded Synthesis Support Summary For Content...” near the end of the monograph.
findings.required_repair: Remove the generated source-route digest/control-sheet material from the public monograph or move it to the evidence package. Replace it with concise scholarly appendix prose that synthesizes the scientific role, evidence boundary, and reviewer use without repeated corpus-routing templates. Re-audit the public PDF so the master reads as one integrated manuscript, with zero generated source-route blocks in the public narrative.

waterfall_policy.current_release_blocker_rule: CRITICAL/HIGH first; no MEDIUM/LOW or taste-polish may enter the release-blocking queue.

coverage_note: publication-grade public PDF manuscript set; deterministic full-text hashes plus representative LLM editorial excerpts
